activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Never have I seen such a result is a question because it begins with never.
cards.explanation: It is an emphatic declarative sentence.

cards.statement: Not until Friday they replied is the preferred formal order.
cards.explanation: Use Not until Friday did they reply.

cards.statement: Only then did we understand the risk has the correct inverted order.
cards.explanation: Did comes before the subject we.

cards.statement: No sooner had the report appeared when journalists called is the standard version.
cards.explanation: No sooner is normally followed by than.

cards.statement: In “Not only did she answer, but she supplied evidence”, did is followed by the base verb answer.
cards.explanation: Did carries the past tense, so answer stays in the base form.

cards.statement: Never I have seen such a result is the standard inverted order.
cards.explanation: Use Never have I seen such a result.

cards.statement: If the negative expression stays later in the sentence, inversion is generally unnecessary.
cards.explanation: We rarely receive complaints has normal order.

cards.statement: A negative expression at the beginning can trigger inversion in a formal statement.
cards.explanation: This is the central use of negative inversion.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Under no circumstances should you open the valve is a prohibition.
cards.explanation: Should precedes the subject after the fronted phrase.

cards.statement: Not only did Lina solve the problem, but she documented it has correct parallel structure.
cards.explanation: The first clause inverts and the second retains normal order.

cards.statement: Hardly had we arrived when the alarm sounded is a standard form.
Barely had I sat down when the phone rang follows the correct pair.
cards.explanation: Barely combines with past-perfect inversion and when.

cards.statement: Only then do we understand the risk is possible when the main verb is present tense.
cards.explanation: Do is used with a present-simple main verb.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 6 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: On no account you should share the code is the preferred formal structure.
cards.explanation: Use On no account should you share the code.

cards.statement: The inversion pattern after not until applies to the main clause, not necessarily to the until-clause.
cards.explanation: Only the main clause takes the inverted auxiliary.

cards.statement: Little we did realise how serious the delay was is correct.
Only after the audit did we change the policy is grammatical.
cards.explanation: The main clause uses did before we.

cards.statement: At no time had the team been informed of the change is correct.
cards.explanation: Had precedes the subject in the past perfect.

cards.statement: Rarely do researchers ignore the control group is grammatical.
cards.explanation: Do is followed by the plural subject and base verb.
